_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. experience 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. Teaches Harvest at the Ruebenfeld, the peasant-onboarding chore gate (GDD 5). ⚑ QUESTS: offers and turns in `turnip-chore` — its target species is only damageable by the `harvest`-tagged aura he teaches, which is why the quest brief points back at his teaching row. ⚑ Q4 SHAPE (conversation-journal §4.6, R1): greeting at root, the quest behind its own row with its brief as that node's text, the teaching a named row at root. Quest rows carry NO quest_at_stage gate — a row is shown iff its ledger op would succeed (the Q1 show-rule).
name: Farmer

lines: Tend the field or go out there adventuring — I know what I would pick.

options.text: Show me how the harvesting is done.

grants.line: If adventuring becomes too stressful, there is always farming!

lines: The north row is ready and I am not. Five turnips out of the ground before the boars find them.
And not by hand — ask me to show you the harvesting first. I'll not have you bruising the crop.

grants.line: Five will do. And mind the treeline while you're bent over.

options.text: Your turnips are out of the ground.

grants.line: ...Aye. All five. The row would have rotted without you, and I'll not pretend otherwise.
Honest work. It counts for something, whatever the crier says.
